name: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Block
description: Adds an 'EPT Block' Paragraphs type whose main field is a block_field reference to any Drupal block plugin, alongside optional title/text fields and the EPT family's shared per-paragraph design settings.
project_description: Extra Paragraph Types (EPT): Block adds a Paragraphs bundle 'EPT Block' that lets an editor embed an existing Drupal block plugin into a paragraph via the block_field module's field, so a block can be positioned in a page's paragraph flow like any other component. The paragraph carries an optional title and text plus the EPT family's shared per-paragraph design settings (margin/padding/border, background color/image/video, edge-to-edge, container width) provided by ept_core. The block is chosen with block_field's widget (restricted to the site's block categories) and rendered with block_field's formatter, which access-checks the chosen block for the current viewer before rendering. Part of the EPT family built on ept_core; install only the paragraph types you need.
